description: This file defines an enumeration class CalendarEventType representing different types of calendar events such as meetings, calls, and tasks. It includes methods to retrieve the associated bean type for each enum value.

classes.name: CalendarEventType
classes.description: An enum class representing different calendar event types with a method to get the corresponding bean type string.

methods.name: getBeanType
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the bean type ('Meetings', 'Calls', or 'Tasks') based on the enumeration value.
